_comment: Agent mode: the Pi pulls each room's controller binding from the backend, so you connect the OptiClimate in the Cannabits Pro UI (host + port) and this file stays tiny. api and key come from gateway.env; `cannabits-gateway enroll <code>` fills in planId. allowControl: true lets this gateway WRITE setpoints the platform queues for its rooms, and never outside guardBand. controllerNetworks: the only networks the gateway reaches a controller in (private ranges only; unset = all private ranges). syncPolicy: full, aggregated (hourly means) or local_only (readings stay here for localRetentionDays); the stricter of this and the platform's setting applies.
